gaps.explanation: Statement p4 Total Governmental Funds receipts 6,167,027; General Fund column Local 683,354 (= p5 combining: General Fund 683,353 + Veteran's Aid 1), with Sale of assets 115 printed separately under Other financing sources. Detail takes the General Fund from the p8 Budgetary Comparison Schedule, whose actual Local is 683,469 (total receipts 3,867,008) and includes the sale of assets: 683,469 - 683,353 = 116 = sale of assets 115 (other financing on pp4-5, a receipt on the budget schedule) + 1 rounding printed by the budget schedule (p5 General Fund 3,866,892 + 115 = 3,867,007 vs 3,867,008). Detail Local total 683,469 + 1 + 106,717 + 1,513 + 155,025 = 946,725 vs statement 946,609 (diff 116). Both totals printed as such; no fix.

Statement p4 Total column Transfers - in 801,688 (Road Fund only); the General Fund column (p5 Total General Fund nets Inheritance Tax Fund to General Fund 200,000: printed General Fund column in 0) and the Non-Major Funds column (911 Wireless Fund to 911 Emergency Management Fund 16,058, p7, printed 0 on p4) net their internal transfers. Detail records them gross per fund: General Fund 200,000 (p8) + Road Fund 801,688 (p9) + 911 Emergency Management Fund 16,058 (p7) = 1,017,746. 1,017,746 - 801,688 = 216,058 = 200,000 + 16,058. Gross-per-fund vs netted columns; no fix.

Statement p4 Total column Transfers - out (801,688) (General Fund column only, net of the 200,000 Inheritance Tax Fund to General Fund transfer inside the General Fund combining statement p5, which prints Total General Fund out 1,001,688 / in 200,000; Non-Major column prints 0, netting 911 Wireless to 911 Emergency Management 16,058, p7). Detail records gross per fund: General Fund -801,688 (p8) + Inheritance Tax Fund -200,000 (p5) + 911 Wireless Fund -16,058 (p7) = -1,017,746. 1,017,746 - 801,688 = 216,058 = 200,000 + 16,058. Gross-per-fund vs netted columns; no fix.
